_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff Default v3.1.263

SysID now distinguishes an incomplete scan, a quality-rejected comparison and an accepted measured result. Fallback or synthesized gains do not appear as measured and cannot supply PID. The steady seven-phase view includes vented recovery; recovery consumes every acquired frame instead of restarting falsely when GUI polling skips frames.

Plot controls stay above the first plot after font/style/resize changes. Tabs and events/connections/device controls share one header; RUN is steady with meaningful phase/break status. Rounded OLED header and progress boxes use the device framebuffer mirrored in the GUI. Default retains its five presets and GUI/standalone parity.

Live NI BPF matches offline zero-phase morphology with an explicit approximately 8.2-second display delay. Pulse-envelope and tracking diagnostics report measured cadence, amplitude, phase lag, error and limitations. NI timestamps remain unchanged. Flow zero uses the 2.9-3.1 V band for five continuous NI seconds. CVP inflation assistance below 1 mmHg/s and smooth valve/tail transitions remain included. Smart Const finds a coherent 30-140 mmHg deflation oscillogram peak and reinflates to peak+10, holding peak+5.

Validation: all five actual GUI presets completed both pulse-enabled cycles with 100% delivery. Arm/Wrist adjacent tail steps were 0.07/0.09 duty percentage points with no detected envelope steps at 10/15/30 mmHg. NI retained 705,650 native samples, zero backtracks. The final firmware-242 ten-minute seed-213 soak completed six cycles with no flags, zero significant pump/valve deflation reversals and 100% delivery. Smart MAP properly rejected pulses-off soak traces. Regular/High rapid-tail envelope windows remain insufficient near 10 mmHg; a matched passive baseline and final two-cuff transfer validation are not established. These measurements do not establish 1000-device yield.

Firmware rev27v-followup-242. Safety thresholds and branch control profiles are unchanged by display work. Protected flashing snapshots/restores complete device state. The installer includes app-local Python and Arduino runtime; NI-DAQmx is optional and installed separately. Accepted calibration submissions remain queued until individual Issues-only enrollment and maintainer review. No shared credential is bundled, and previous calibration JSON remains archived.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
